purpose: Select one non-training exact elimination context whose ordinary explicit resolution materialization exceeds the same frozen cap, without using any future factorizer behavior to choose the specimen.

training_exclusion.reason: The PHP_5_4 obstruction motivated the representation grammar and cannot serve as an independent holdout.

frozen_source_corpus.name: C025_OPEN3_STAGE4_SCALING_LADDER
frozen_source_corpus.scientific_boundary: Finite bounded corpus only; successful Stage4 coverage is not a totality theorem.

deterministic_formula_order.clause_universe: Exactly experiments/direct/janus_open3_stage4_bounded_coverage_probe.py clause_universe ordering: canonical clauses sorted by (len(clause), clause).
deterministic_formula_order.formula_enumeration: itertools.combinations(universe, clause_count) in Python deterministic lexicographic combination order, followed by canonicalization, exact variable-count filter, fingerprint de-duplication, primal-connected filter and the preregistered connected limit.
deterministic_formula_order.rung_order: R1 then R2 then R3 then R4.
deterministic_formula_order.eligibility: Only formulas for which stage3.solve_one_variable_escape returns neither SAT nor UNSAT and hence are members of OPEN3.

frozen_context_enumeration_per_formula.macro_order: Use v2.all_or_pair_candidates on the exact source state, unchanged.
frozen_context_enumeration_per_formula.macro_fresh_variable: max(live variables and root variables, default 0) + 1, matching frozen Stage4 v3.
frozen_context_enumeration_per_formula.first_elimination_order: Ascending variables that were live before the macro, using base.eliminate_var_capped with the same frozen cap.
frozen_context_enumeration_per_formula.probe_pivot_order: For each exact context state, inspect each variable still live in that state in ascending numeric order.

diagnostic_explicit_elimination.definition: For a context CNF C and pivot x, partition positive/negative/untouched clauses; enumerate the complete positive-times-negative resolution product; omit tautological resolvents; canonicalize and deduplicate exact resolvents; reconstruct the exact ordinary-resolution CNF C' = untouched union unique non-tautological resolvents.

holdout_selection_rule: Freeze the FIRST eligible tuple in the fully deterministic order (rung, formula, context type/order, macro candidate if any, first pivot if any, probe pivot) for which exact explicit elimination yields state_units strictly above the same frozen cap.

no_hit_rule.if_no_context_in_frozen_corpus_matches: Emit and freeze status NO_HOLDOUT_FOUND_IN_FROZEN_OPEN3_CORPUS with exact counts and corpus hash commitments.
no_hit_rule.then: Preregister a deterministic expanded search before examining any expanded-search result.
no_hit_rule.forbidden: Do not weaken or change the selection condition after a no-hit.

C010_PROOF_COMPRESSION: DAG sharing may only postpone full expansion.
Dependency depth is an independently charged resource.
Coefficient/encoding growth or expanded size cannot be hidden by a compact surface representation.
C020_FORMULA_CACHING_BARRIER: A compact cache/DAG representation is not automatically p-equivalent to ordinary Resolution.
Incoming contexts/reuse edges and cache proof rules are separately charged resources.
historical_adversarial_debts_carried_for.POLICY0A_CONTEXT_INTERSECTION: Context-independent reuse can fail when one state is reached under incompatible decision boundaries; shared-node semantics must carry sufficient context.
historical_adversarial_debts_carried_for.POLICY0A_DIAMOND_BYPASS: Speedup over one execution policy is not evidence of a proof-system separation or universal complexity gain.

success_interpretation.holdout_found: Produces a blind exact representation challenge only; it says nothing about whether the preregistered factor grammar will pass.
success_interpretation.future_factorizer_pass: Would establish one finite exact non-training representation pass only.
success_interpretation.future_factorizer_fail: Is a valid falsification of the v1 representation/admission route on that frozen holdout.

next_allowed_code: A holdout-search instrument implementing only this frozen deterministic enumeration and explicit diagnostic elimination. It may import frozen Stage3/Stage4 components but MUST NOT contain or import factorized-resolution representation code.
